args.name: page
args.doc: home, quote, quote/<product>, insurance/<product>, my-policies, my-policies/<policy_id>, claim. Products: car, bike, health, term, home, travel.

moves.doc: Go to one page of the site, ringing the nav item or the card that leads there first.
Move the EN / हिंदी toggle by the call button to the language the call is now in. The brain has already moved both speech legs.
Put that product's quote builder on screen: stays on /insurance/<product> or /quote/<product> when that product's builder is already showing, else goes to /quote/<product>. Rings the product tab.

args.name: field
args.doc: A quote field id of the product on screen (data/products.json).

args.name: value
args.doc: The value as the form stores it: an option value (suv, pune, 1000000) or a number (1400000).

moves.doc: Ring the quote field, set it, and let the premium recompute. Refused with the options when the value is not one of them, or when no quote builder is on screen.

args.name: addon
args.doc: An add-on id of the product on screen.

moves.doc: Ring the add-on's toggle and switch it on or off; its line appears or leaves the breakdown. Refused, with why, when the add-on is unavailable for these answers.
Scroll to and ring the premium breakdown panel.

args.name: policy_id
args.doc: A policy id of the signed-in customer (data/customer.json).

args.name: section
args.doc: A section id of that document, to scroll to.

moves.doc: Open the customer's policy document at /my-policies/<policy_id> (and scroll to a section).

args.name: clause_id
args.doc: A clause id in that document, e.g. 3.4.

moves.doc: Open the document if it is not open, scroll to the clause, ring it, highlight it and pin a verdict chip on it (Covered, Not covered, Covered with limits, Depends). Earlier marks are cleared.
Go to /claim, choose the claim type (and the policy), and open the form at its first section. Keeps what is already filled when the type is the same.

args.name: value
args.doc: Option value, date YYYY-MM-DD, time HH:MM, number, or text.

moves.doc: Open the field's section, ring the field and set it. Refused with the options for a value the field does not take, or for a field hidden by the answers so far.

args.name: section
args.doc: A section id: policy, incident, driver, other_party, police, garage, patient, treatment, bank, documents, review.

moves.doc: Open a section of the claim form, scroll to it and ring it (documents: rings the uploads still missing).
Check every section like the Review button and open the review step. Refused naming the fields still missing. Never submits: the customer ticks the declaration and presses Submit claim.

slices.doc: the quote builder on screen: product, answers, add-ons on, and the total

fields.name: field
fields.doc: The field or add-on that just changed.

fields.name: addons
fields.doc: Ids of the add-ons switched on.

slices.doc: the claim form: type, section in front, which fields hold something (names only) and which documents are uploaded

fields.name: field
fields.doc: The field or document that just changed.

slices.doc: the language the visitor chose on the toggle

events.doc: A quote field or add-on changed.
A claim field changed, or the type or section did.

events.ask: thank them, give the claim reference and say what happens next from the claims guide, in two short sentences
